meta.title: ReproSense
meta.description: A private record of cycles, pain scores and lab results that her gynaecologist can read in a minute. It shows the entries behind every pattern and never diagnoses. Demo with fictional data.
meta.ogAlt: ReproSense, a woman's cycle record prepared for her doctor

chrome.footer: ReproSense gives information, not a diagnosis. In an emergency call 998. Demo data is fictional. Built with AI tools.

demo.title: Eight fictional women, five life stages, one clinic network.
demo.intro: Each woman has twelve months of generated daily logs, lab reports and events. Every number in this demo comes from the build kit's synthetic data generator.
demo.staffIntro: The clinician sees only women who shared a report. The network admin sees follow-ups across clinics, without names.
demo.resetDone: Demo data reset. You're now signed in as the clinic network admin.

need.patient: Pick a woman below to open her app.
need.clinician: Open the clinician view to see the clinic's patients.
need.admin: Open the clinic network to see follow-ups across clinics.

demo.apiDownBody: Start the API with make api in the repository folder, then try again.

insights.title: Patterns
insights.intro: What we noticed in your entries. Written rules decide, published guidelines ground each card, and nothing here is a diagnosis.

insights.noneBody: When your entries match a pattern doctors look at, it appears here with the days behind it and its source. Keep logging; we check every time you save.
insights.traceIntro: Every card goes through the same steps. Rules decide; the language model only explains, and every sentence is checked against a source.

checkin.title: Mood check (EPDS)
checkin.intro: Ten questions about how you have felt in the past 7 days, not just today. It takes about two minutes. Your answers go into your record; only you and a clinic you share with can see them.
checkin.instruction: Choose the answer that comes closest to how you have felt in the past 7 days.
checkin.question: Question {n} of 10
checkin.required: Answer all ten questions first. Question {n} has no answer yet.
checkin.doneBody: Your answers were added to your record.
checkin.total: Total: {total} of 30. A score is not a diagnosis.
checkin.talk: If anything here worries you, talk to your midwife or doctor.
checkin.arNote: The questions are shown in English until the validated Arabic version is added.
checkin.cardBody: Ten questions about the past 7 days, about two minutes.

documents.title: Lab reports
documents.intro: Upload a lab report as a PDF or text file. We read the values; you check each one against your paper copy, then confirm. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

documents.confirmed: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing was saved.} one {# result saved. Your record was checked again.} other {# results saved. Your record was checked again.}}
documents.noRows: No lab values were recognised in this file. Check that it is the text or PDF version of the report.

privacy.title: Privacy centre
privacy.intro: Who can see your record, who has seen it, and your own copy of everything.

promises.0: We never sell or advertise on health data.
promises.2: Clinics see your record only while you share it, and every view is logged here.
promises.3: AI calls receive de-identified data only: no names, relative dates.

purpose.care_share: Share my record with my clinic
purpose.research: Include my de-identified data in research

privacy.discreetBody: Shows “My notes” instead of the app name and hides your name and initial on screen.
privacy.deleteBody: Removes your entries, reports, share links and drafts. In this demo, Reset demo data on the demo page brings them back.
privacy.deleteConfirmBody: This removes everything you have logged. In a real account it can't be undone.
